import re
content = """# My Bucket List ([x] = done, [ ] = not done))

[ ] Witnessing a total solar eclipse
[ ] Learning to play a musical instrument
[ ] Writing a book or novel
[x] Traveling to at least 5 different continents
[x] Taking a cooking class in a foreign country
[x] Bungee jumping from a high platform
[x] Going on a meditation or yoga retreat
[ ] Watching a Broadway show in New York City
[x] Riding the Trans-Siberian Railway
[x] Exploring the Amazon rainforest
"""
done = re.findall(r'^\[x\]', content, flags=re.M)
not_done = re.findall(r'^\[ \]', content, flags=re.M)
all_items = re.findall(r'^\[[ x]\]', content, flags=re.M)
print('done',len(done))
print('not_done',len(not_done))
print('all',len(all_items))

import re
bucket_note_id=251
bucket_note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_note_token, note_id=bucket_note_id)
content=bucket_note.get('content','')
done_count=len(re.findall(r'^\[x\]', content, flags=re.M))
print('done_count',done_count)
print('matches',re.findall(r'^\[x\].*', content, flags=re.M))
